title: Family Posing at Grand Canyon Scenic Overlook, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona, United States
description: A vintage 1950s black-and-white snapshot capturing a happy family of four posing together on a sunlit rocky cliff edge overlooking a vast canyon landscape, characteristic of the Grand Canyon. The group consists of a mother in a modest short-sleeved dress, a father wearing glasses with a camera strap hanging at his side, a teenage daughter in cuffed trousers and a sleeveless collared shirt, and a younger daughter in a polka-dot summer sundress. The scene exemplifies mid-century American postwar vacation and national park road trip culture.
